kind.instructions: What kind of document is document.text?

criteria.invoice: A bill or invoice requesting payment
criteria.statement: A bank, card or investment statement
criteria.tax: A tax form or tax correspondence
criteria.medical: Medical records, bills or insurance EOBs
criteria.correspondence: A letter or email that is none of the above

action_needed.instructions: Does document.text ask the owner to do something by a deadline (pay, sign, respond, file)?

financial.instructions: Does document.text concern money owed, paid, held or invested by the owner?

sensitive.instructions: Does document.text contain account numbers, tax IDs, health details or other sensitive personal data?
